## Summary

Describe the focused change and why it is needed.

## Checks

- [ ] `make check`
- [ ] Documentation updated when user-facing behavior changes.
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behavior changes.

## Boundaries

- [ ] The change keeps reusable Android mechanics in `src/android_harness/`.
- [ ] The change keeps optional integrations in `plugins/`.
- [ ] The change does not add app-specific business flows, account data, detection evasion, or platform bypass logic to core.
